purpose: Executable permanent regression coverage for GitHub issues #2 through #13

stages.description: Validate issue traceability, exact test selectors, current source existence, and CI routing.
Run every non-Docker package normally plus static checks.
Run every non-Docker package under the race detector.
Run restrictive-umask real ejabberd regression profiles.
Run the focused XEP-0215 independent-NAT public Core smoke.

issues.title: Retire Rank 2 payload-transfer ownership with its carrier session

tests.proof: A retired private carrier-session owner cannot delete or mutate the replacement transfer lane; this lifetime token is not application membership authority.

issues.title: Keep the Rank 1 receive pump nonblocking while transfer routes are unresolved

tests.proof: An unresolved transfer cannot block a later authenticated envelope in the sole receive pump.
Unresolved work remains bounded by count and retained bytes and releases its ownership.

issues.title: Decouple Jingle handshake execution from the Rank 1 signal receive loop

tests.proof: A blocked handshake worker cannot stop authenticated signal admission.
Per-peer execution stays single-flight while the newest authorized restart receives service.

issues.title: Add byte-bounded, carrier-capability-aware admission for Rank 2 transfer work

tests.proof: Rank 2 transfer admission rejects unresolved work at its byte boundary before normal worker ownership.

issues.title: Add a byte budget to the XEP-0198 replay ledger

tests.proof: Replay admission enforces exact byte capacity and acknowledgement releases it exactly once.

issues.title: Prevent rejected concurrent callback registration from blocking for 30 seconds

tests.proof: Concurrent registration has one winner and promptly disposes every unstarted loser.

issues.title: Retire Rank 1 restart sessions when live links are retired

tests.proof: Only the restart session owned by the retired live-link token is removed.
A real independently NATed pair reaches and retains a live peer link for bidirectional public traffic.

issues.title: Make payload reassembly quota include all full-payload buffers

tests.proof: Reassembly moves one canonical buffer and releases every owned byte without a full-payload clone.
Encrypted output capacity is reserved before decryption allocation and is recovered on failure.

issues.title: Reject unusably small Rank 1 negotiated message limits

tests.proof: Every local maximum-message boundary rejects minimum-minus-one and accepts the exact protocol minimum.
The exact central minimum carries both mandatory health traffic and the smallest valid envelope.

issues.title: Reject relay-only connectivity profiles without a TURN server

tests.proof: A relay-only authenticated ICE profile without TURN fails before peer construction.
Authenticated XEP-0215 supplies short-lived TURN allocation to an independent-NAT forced-relay exchange.

issues.title: Map context deadlines according to the SDK operation being performed

tests.proof: Direct and wrapped deadlines map by exact public operation without delivery misclassification.

issues.title: Make the ejabberd Docker qualification harness independent of caller umask

tests.proof: The self-contained normal pinned ejabberd profile remains executable under restrictive caller umask.
The self-contained shared-group profile stages container-readable module and rendered configuration under restrictive caller umask.
